content:
elaine: heads up — noticed ~120 canceled subscriptions in Stripe that never marked as refunded/cancelled in NetSuite. customers seeing invoices still open.

matt: yikes. when did this start?

jordan: I see a spike in webhook DLQ entries around 2026-03-22T23:00Z — looks like signature verification failures.

elaine: yep, Stripe webhook logs show a batch of events with status 410 and error SigVerificationFailed.

elaine: example from logs:
```
{"id":"evt_1Lxyz","type":"customer.subscription.deleted","received_at":"2026-03-22T23:01:12Z","status":"dead","error":"signature_verification_failed"}
```

sara: any recent secret rotations? I rotated a stripe key last night for test accounts but thought production was untouched.

matt: I rotated the signing secret earlier during the deploy window and updated the consumer env VAR in staging only. forgot prod. sorry.

jordan: that explains it. DLQ has ~125 events for subscription.deleted. Our DLQ replayer is manual; currently paused due to idempotency concerns (we saw dup invoices after replay in feb).

billing-bot: Automated check: 125 events in DLQ, newest at 2026-03-22T23:12:03Z. Last successful delivery: 2026-03-22T22:59:58Z.

matt: immediate plan: 1) update prod webhook secret, 2) run a safe replay with dedupe guard on subscription IDs, 3) run invoices reconciliation job to mark and refund or void as necessary.

ops-bot: deploy window currently open until 02:00Z. No conflicting deploys.

elaine: Jordan, can you add a quick dedupe script? we only want to process events where NetSuite doesn't have a matching cancellation/refund.

jordan: on it. will push script to /scripts/replay-safe.sh and run a dry-run first.

jordan: dry-run output (sample):
```
would-process: evt_1Labc -> sub_3245 (netSuite invoice id: null)
would-skip: evt_1Ldef -> sub_9982 (netSuite invoice already voided)
```

sara: how long to finish the safe replay if approved?

matt: ~30m to update secret and run dry-run, then ~45m to actual replay and reconciliation. total ~1.5h.

elaine: sounds good. also put a guard to not auto-issue refunds without finance approval for invoices > $5k. add that to the script.

jordan: ack — will add threshold check and output a list for manual review for >5k.

matt: I'm going to update the PROD env var now. will post when done.

(matt updates webhook secret)
matt: done. prod webhook signing secret updated.

billing-bot: Re-checking webhook delivery... 5 new deliveries succeeded in the last 2m. DLQ count still 125 until replay.

elaine: proceed with dry-run and share summary before actual replay.

jordan: dry-run complete — 118 events would process, 7 would be skipped, 4 flagged >5k. attaching CSV to the finance ticket.

matt: approved to proceed with replay for the 118 events (finance ok with manual handling for the 4 flagged).

jordan: running replay now with dedupe + refund-threshold guard.

jordan: replay finished. 118 processed -> 110 invoices voided, 4 flagged for manual refund review, 4 had partial refunds created automatically (under threshold).

sara: thanks. I'll coordinate with finance for the 4 manual refunds. can someone add a postmortem entry with action items?

elaine: action items I have: 
- Add webhook secret rotation runbook and checklist (assign matt)
- Add automatic test that verifies webhook signature after deploy (assign eng-infra)
- Enhance DLQ replayer with idempotency tokens and a dry-run mode (assign jordan)
- Finance: confirm refunds for the 4 flagged invoices (assign sara)

matt: I'll own the runbook and update the deploy checklist now.

billing-bot: Incident created: FIN-2026-031-03. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2026-031-03

elaine: closing this thread — reopen if anything misses reconciliation.
